h1. Team On-boarding

Welcome to the team! This document covers everything you need to get up to speed.

h2. Prerequisites

* Git — [https://git-scm.com]
* Java 17+ — [https://adoptium.net]
* Node 18+ — [https://nodejs.org]
* Your favourite IDE (IntelliJ IDEA recommended for the backend, VS Code for the frontend)

h2. First-day Checklist

# Clone the repository
# Run the backend: {{./mvnw spring-boot:run}}
# Run the frontend: {{npm install && npm start}}
# Read the [Architecture Overview|architecture/overview]
# Ask a question in the team channel

h2. Conventions

h3. Document IDs

Documents use kebab-case slugs. Category subdirectories use the same convention.

||Good||Bad||
|{{team/on-boarding}}|{{Team/OnBoarding}}|
|{{architecture/data-flow}}|{{Architecture_DataFlow}}|

h3. Writing Style

{tip}
Keep headings short. Use *bold* for key terms on first use. Prefer lists over long paragraphs.
{tip}
